P1 Required Revision: Pre-mark real databases before fake can claim them. Every existing database starts unclaimed because the migration explicitly performs no backfill, while the rule lets either driver claim that state. During first rollout or after an owner-record reset, the persistent Repl database can already contain real test-account mirror rows but have no owner; fake plus the declaration w

P1 Required Revision: Distinguish real-driver selection from live-account authorization. The core promise is not established for the Repl: STRIPE_DRIVER=live is required both for production's live account and for the Repl's test-mode account, so it cannot also be an explicit authorization to contact the live account. The ownership matrix tests a mixed live/fake race but omits the production case where multiple instances claim the same owner concurrently.
